name: Big 12 Cross Country Championships
where: Stillwater, OK · host Oklahoma State · Greiner Family OSU XC Course
headline: Big 12 Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Colorado edged No. 2 Oklahoma State 36-38 for the men's title in Stillwater, with No. 5 BYU third at 91. Oklahoma State's Denis Kipngetich won the 8K in 23:05.7, with Colorado's Dominic Serem second in 23:06.9. In the women's race, No. 1 BYU won with 56 points to No. 3 West Virginia's 63, with No. 7 Oklahoma State third (116) and No. 10 Colorado fourth (117); BYU's Jane Hedengren won the 6K in 19:28.0.
